# System packages the CI jobs install with apt, one per line, first column the job that needs it.
#
# This file is the cache key of the .deb files (.github/actions/system-packages). It exists so the
# key follows the package list and nothing else: the key used to be a hash of ci.yml, so every
# edit to the workflow -- a comment, a timeout, a job name -- threw the cache away and paid for
# ffmpeg again (479 s in run 40207488836, 11.5 min in run 39789916437, because the Azure mirror
# throttles without warning).
#
# Playwright's own library list is not here: it comes from `playwright install-deps` and follows
# the Playwright version, so pnpm-lock.yaml is hashed next to this file.
#
# Format: <job> <package>. Lines starting with # and empty lines are ignored.

# The server tests probe the generated media and run ffmpeg (internal/library, internal/transcode,
# internal/playback), and `task testdata:media` generates that media with ffmpeg in the first place.
server ffmpeg

# The e2e shards need the same ffmpeg, plus PulseAudio for the null sink that Firefox plays the
# audio-only titles through (see the comment at the sink step in ci.yml).
e2e ffmpeg
e2e pulseaudio
e2e pulseaudio-utils
